description: Generate a slide-deck-quality pyramid or funnel: 2–8 stacked layers in even steps, narrow at the top in pyramid mode (a hierarchy of needs, a strategy pyramid, foundations to vision) or wide at the top in funnel mode (sales, marketing or hiring funnels). Each layer has a name and an optional detail line beside it. Choose it when items stack in a ranked order or narrow down stage by stage; use a process diagram for a sequence of phases of equal weight, a cycle for a loop, a hub and spoke for parts around a centre, and a timeline when dates matter. Limits: 2–8 layers; keep names to one to four words and details to one short sentence. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: Stacked layers drawn as a pyramid (narrow at the top) or a funnel (wide at the top), in even steps, with an optional detail beside each layer.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

layers.description: The layers, top to bottom (2–8; extra layers are dropped with a warning). In a pyramid the first layer is the narrow tip; in a funnel it is the wide first stage. Names sit inside the shape when they fit, otherwise beside it with a leader line.

color.description: Hex colour for this layer, e.g. "#4f46e5". Optional: layers without one take the next palette colour. The label switches between white and dark for contrast.

detail.description: Optional short description shown in a muted column to the right of the shape, aligned to this layer. Wraps to two lines.

name.description: Layer label, e.g. "Leads" or "Self-actualisation". One to four words read best.

mode.description: "pyramid" (default) narrows toward the top layer, for hierarchies and foundations-to-vision stacks. "funnel" is widest at the top and narrows down, for sales, marketing and hiring stages. Layers are always listed top to bottom.

palette.description: Hex colours applied in order to items that have no colour of their own. Pass the user's brand colours here when they name them. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400). Omit it (recommended) and the chart sizes itself to its content with comfortable margins, between 880 and 1280px wide. PNG output renders at 2x.

inputSchema.title: Pyramid / Funnel
